question: A user on a free Claude account has already created five projects and wants to start a sixth one for a new personal task. What should they expect?
options: A) They can create a sixth project only after deleting the oldest chat from an existing project
B) They can create unlimited projects because free accounts carry no cap on project count at all
C) They can create a sixth project but that project will have no knowledge base feature available
D) They cannot create a sixth project because free accounts are limited to a maximum of five projects
correct_answers: D) They cannot create a sixth project because free accounts are limited to a maximum of five projects
explanations: Incorrect. Deleting a chat does not lift the five-project cap; the limit applies to the count of projects, not chats.
Incorrect. Free accounts are capped at five projects; the cap is not unlimited.
Incorrect. The limitation described is about the number of projects allowed, not about disabling the knowledge base feature on new ones.
Correct. Free Claude accounts can create a maximum of five projects, so a sixth would require removing or upgrading rather than simply creating a new one.
